skill.name: woocommerce-copy-guidelines
skill.description: Guidelines for writing clear WooCommerce UI copy in sentence case, including labels, buttons, headings, and messages.
skill.summary: Apply WooCommerce sentence-case rules to user-facing interface copy.
skill.author: woocommerce

content.user_title: Write WooCommerce copy in sentence case
content.value_statement: WooCommerce teams need consistent interface text across buttons, labels, headings, and messages. This skill applies simple sentence-case rules to user-facing copy.
actual_capabilities: Applies sentence case rules to WooCommerce UI text.
Reviews button labels, headings, menu items, and form labels.
Keeps proper nouns, acronyms, and brand names capitalized.
Converts title-case examples into approved sentence-case copy.
Supports concise, action-oriented wording for product interfaces.
limitations: It covers copy style guidance, not product strategy or legal review.
It does not verify text against a live WooCommerce product screen.
It does not translate copy or validate locale-specific capitalization rules.
It depends on the provided context for brand names and proper nouns.

use_cases.title: Normalize checkout interface text
use_cases.description: Review checkout buttons, labels, and notices so they follow WooCommerce sentence-case rules.

use_cases.title: Edit extension settings copy
use_cases.description: Convert payment, shipping, or tax settings text into clear labels and headings.

use_cases.title: Prepare release-ready UI strings
use_cases.description: Check new interface strings before handoff to engineering or localization teams.

prompt_templates.title: Check a short label list
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of simple UI strings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these WooCommerce UI labels for sentence case. Return the corrected version and a short reason for each change: [paste labels].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite buttons and headings
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate copy cleanup for a feature screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these WooCommerce buttons and headings using sentence case. Preserve brand names and acronyms: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a settings page
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed review of several UI text types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this WooCommerce settings page copy. Group issues by buttons, labels, headings, messages, and menu items: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Create a release copy checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise review checklist for this WooCommerce feature copy. Include sentence case, clarity, consistency, and capitalization exceptions: [paste feature context].

output_examples.input: Payment Provider Options, Save Changes, Enable Test Mode
output_examples.output: Payment provider options, Save changes, Enable test mode

output_examples.input: Configure API Settings, Connect With WooPayments, Generate CSV Export
output_examples.output: Configure API settings, Connect with WooPayments, Generate CSV export

output_examples.input: Please Enter A Valid Email Address
output_examples.output: Please enter a valid email address

best_practices: Use sentence case for all WooCommerce UI copy unless an exception applies.
Keep proper nouns, acronyms, and official brand capitalization unchanged.
Use concise, action-oriented words for buttons and task flows.
anti_patterns: Do not use title case for multi-word buttons, labels, headings, or menu items.
Do not lowercase official brand names, product names, or acronyms.
Do not make UI text longer than needed for the user action.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps write and review WooCommerce interface copy using sentence case and clear product language.

faq.question: Can it rewrite title-case labels?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert title-case UI strings into WooCommerce-approved sentence case.

faq.question: Does it preserve brand names?
faq.answer: Yes. WooCommerce, WordPress, PayPal, Stripe, and similar names keep their official capitalization.

faq.question: Does it support acronyms?
faq.answer: Yes. Acronyms such as API, URL, SSL, and CSV stay capitalized.

faq.question: Is this a localization tool?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on English UI copy rules and does not replace localization review.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
